label: JSON metrics format (Sync Gateway _expvar endpoint)
type: one of the two formats (with sgw:prometheus-metrics-format) the Sync Gateway Metrics REST API can return statistics in, via the _expvar endpoint. Resets on every node restart - not persisted.
note: No stated non-support/exclusion list the way tool:cbcollect-info's docs state - the sgcollect-info.json near-miss's own finding, restated: Sync Gateway's diagnostic surfaces are documented as bounded-positive inventories, never as bounded-negative exclusions.
